scope: Independent mathematical and source-interface review of OHA1–OHA12, not a Lean replay.
checks: Integral double-coset convolution matches the source right-coset sum on fixed vectors; no denominator or characteristic restriction is introduced.

Transpose fixes every GL_n spherical double coset by the displayed Smith factorization. The explicit determinant-weighted matrix Haar measure is left/right invariant and transpose-invariant, so the integral convolution argument gives arbitrary-coefficient commutativity with the correct normalization.

All original HSet.Ax section alternatives are used: W_le/W_dec and auxiliary section commutation for preservation, Wm_mul_Wm_comm for commuting or transport-equivalent places; source factor order is preserved.
The commuting operator algebra is a finite A-module even for infinitely many operator labels, because it is a submodule of the finite endomorphism module over Noetherian A.
The residual relations generate J=m_A T+(T_i-a_i); T/J is either zero or the base residue field, yielding at most one selected local factor.

The source locPart supremum is the increasing union of inverse images under powers. The selected factor satisfies it by nilpotence modulo m_A; every other factor is excluded by invertibility of one shifted generator and separatedness. Hence the exact original locPart is eY over arbitrary complete Noetherian local coefficients.
L∩IY=IL follows from the actual idempotent, so localization is idempotent and finite projectivity/freeness follows without a field-fiber or reducedness assumption.
Restriction eT→T_L is injective using faithfulness on Y and surjective on actual generators, retaining the same scalar and residue maps.

The polynomial formula for u^{-1} is valid for any finite module by lifting u^{-1} to a matrix on finite generators and descending Cayley–Hamilton. It makes each positive generator a unit in the actual Hecke algebra.
The full hiComm quantifiers, all six hiAlg conclusions, zero residual-block case for hiComm, nonzero hypothesis for hiAlg, and domain-only scalar torsion-freeness are preserved.
The arithmetic installation uses FNL16 and the original one OTW12 theta across every level; it does not assert unproved block nonvanishing, arithmetic points, specialization or same-ideal automorphy.
